Interface BuildingCardEffect

All Known Implementing Classes:
ArtistSustenanceDiscountEffect, BuilderPrestigeMultiplierEffect, ExtraCardOnRoundEndEffect, ExtraFoodOnTotemEffect, ExtraResourcesOnCavePaintingsEffect, ExtraResourcesOnHuntEffect, ExtraShamanStarsEffect, FoodPerInventorPairEffect, FoodPerSetEffect, GathererSustenanceDiscountEffect, InventorSustenanceDiscountEffect, NoEffect, PrestigePerCharacterEffect, PrestigePerSetEffect, ShamanicDoubleRewardEffect, ShamanicPenaltyImmunityEffect
public interface BuildingCardEffect
Defines the effects applied by a building card.
